title: Sonate Fantaisie
identity: Sonate Fantaisie is Pierre-Max Dubois’s 1979 alto saxophone and piano work, Billaudot GB3038. A scholarly appendix gives duration about 13:30 and its dedication to George Gourdet; the catalog note supplies three section headings.

evidence.claim: LMI lists Billaudot GB3038 and instrumentation.
IPCB thesis appendix lists 1979, saxophone/piano, dedication and approx. 13:30 duration.
evidence.source_name: Polytechnic Institute of Castelo Branco thesis

review_focus: Inference: the documented 13:30 duration and three section labels support checking pacing and character changes across the full score.
collection_flag: Published saxophone/piano work with documented dedicatee; composer’s wider saxophone catalogue is substantial.
gaps: Movement names rely on catalog notes, not the publisher page.
